4490-8335--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4490-8335--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Neelix triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
4490-8335--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2105-5434-5895-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5434-5895-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5434-5895-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2023-3755-4770-7730.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

240-5470-6495-6965.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat from step 2.
240-5470-6495-6965.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

628-1325-5670--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
628-1325-5670--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When it enters, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing each opponent to lose life and you to gain life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its undying ability from Mikaeus triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When it enters, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing each opponent to lose life and you to gain life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat

582-1409-7824.description:
Activate Brazen Freebooter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Brazen Freebooter.
Resolve the Brazen Freebooter trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2034-5320-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature or a permanent with a way to sacrifice it.
2034-5320-7824.description:
Use Ashnod's Altar to sacrifice another creature, or sacrifice a permanent by any other method.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens due to Bard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Sorcerer's Broom tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Sorcerer's Broom triggers twice, and each Sorcerer's Broom token triggers once.
Resolve all but one trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the final trigger, causing you to pay {3} to create two creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
2034-5320-7824.notes: If you sacrifice a creature to start using Ashnod's Altar, the starting cost is reduced to {1}. You can instead use a permanent that can sacrifice itself (like a Treasure token) or another method to sacrifice a permanent (like Braids, Arisen Nightmare).

4613-4968-6843-7741.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Shang-Chi.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3094-4659-5390-5434-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
3094-4659-5390-5434-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {2} due to Forensic Gadgeteer and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

933-5153-7150.easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
933-5153-7150.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Sunstrike Legionnaire. copying Conjurer's Closet's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Conjurer's Closet's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3532-4668-5078-6604.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
3532-4668-5078-6604.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2044-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Peema Outrider.
When Peema Outrider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Peema Outrider enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

338-5641-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-5641-6719.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-4289-5295-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

4659-5365-5494-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
4659-5365-5494-6753.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

232-4790-5542.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Repeat.

1861-6464.description:
Cast Cut Your Losses by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing an opponent to mill half their library, rounded down.
Activate Keening Stone by paying {5} and tapping it, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the number of cards in their graveyard, thus milling the rest of their library.
1861-6464.notes: If the opponent has an odd number of cards in their library and an empty graveyard, the opponent will have one card remaining in their library. Otherwise they will mill their entire library. You can also pay the casualty cost if desired.

1789-4875-5649-5686.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-4875-5649-5686.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-4763-5553-6068.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
1069-4763-5553-6068.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Greedy Freebooter.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, targeting Koll.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Greedy Freebooter by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

801-1069-3156-4763.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts, including an Equipment except Demonmail Hauberk.
801-1069-3156-4763.description:
Activate an equipment except Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Impulsive Pilferer.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, targeting Koll.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

618-1938-3967.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glorious Protector.
When the Glorious Protector token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Glorious Protector token.
When the Glorious Protector token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1018-2104-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation and Skullwinder each turn.
1018-2104-6122.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Skullwinder by paying its mana cost.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Skullwinder from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1850-3549-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Seraph Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Seraph Sanctuary, triggering its first ability and Fastbond.
Resolve the Seraph Sanctuary trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Activate Seraph Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2011-3973-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Rith does not have summoning sickness.
There is at least eight permanents of any one color on the battlefield.
An opponent cannot block Rith.
2011-3973-4050.description:
Declare Rith and Najeela, if desired, as attackers.
If one or more Warriors attack, Najeela triggers, creating that many 1/1 Warrior creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using Rith.
Rith triggers, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Saprolings, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase.
Repeat steps 1-3 one additional time.
Rith triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {2}{G}.
Resolve the Rith trigger, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Repeat from step 5.
 If there are at least nine permanents of any color on the battlefield and/or you control a Warrior that can attack, this combo nets infinite creature tokens and colored mana.

1641-2034-4452-4720.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

575-4674-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a green card in hand.
575-4674-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning Temur Charger face up.
Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.
